stories.title: Seattle Public Schools pressures court to pause ban on trans athletes in girls’ sports
stories.summary: Seattle Public Schools filed a legal brief on Wednesday night in support of preventing Initiative 638 from taking effect.

stories.title: 2 people shot in Seattle's ​Chinatown-International District
stories.summary: According to the Seattle Police Department, the victims were reportedly shot Wednesday night near 12th Avenue South and South Welles Street.

stories.title: Auburn Riverside tennis star solves Rubik's Cube in under 20 seconds as Ravens chase state championship
stories.summary: Auburn Riverside tennis star Evan Ly, known for solving Rubik's Cubes in seconds, leads his high school team to district victory with sights set on a state title.

stories.title: Skylights return to Washington State Capitol in $8.6 million restoration
stories.summary: The work is scheduled to be complete when legislators return to Olympia next January.

stories.title: Downtown Seattle banks on holiday visitors to boost business
stories.summary: The Gingerbread Village kicks off the holiday season in downtown Seattle. Several more events begin next week.

stories.title: Big Game of the Week: How to watch Enumclaw vs. Mount Tahoma
stories.summary: Every Friday night, KING 5 will highlight local high school football teams around the region with the Big Game of the Week livestream.

stories.title: WIAA outlines girls sports affected by Washington's new I-638 law
stories.summary: A Washington law, effective Dec. 3, limits high school girls' sports to biological females. The initiative, backed by voters, impacts several sports seasons.

stories.title: Washington medical organizations 'deeply troubled' by trans girls sports ban, support pausing new law
stories.summary: The state's medical association and other healthcare organizations voiced support for a lawsuit seeking to pause implementation of I-638.

stories.title: Man charged in Queen Anne gas station homicide extradited to King County
stories.summary: Michael Anthony O'Neal Fleming was arrested in Chicago in October and has been charged with first-degree murder. He was booked into King County Jail Tuesday.

stories.title: Southbound I-5 reopens in Kent after overnight 3-car crash in construction zone
stories.summary: A juvenile driver that caused the crash was transported to the hospital, according to the WSP.

stories.title: Fall City teen accused of killing 5 family members appears in court, pleads not guilty
stories.summary: King County Judge Veronica Galván previously ruled the teen will be tried as an adult.

stories.title: UW, Harborview staff walk out to protest alleged offer of 0% raises
stories.summary: The union stated that bargaining is at an impasse, but the university said negotiations are continuing in good faith.
